logline: A room that does not hurry. One lamp, late rain, and ten quiet Mandarin jazz scenes.

comics.en: One lamp stays after the rain.
The window keeps the water moving slowly.
An empty chair keeps the tea warm in memory.
No one asks the night to answer.
